description: This Java class is a REST controller named NoteController that provides CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) for notes at the /api/notes endpoint. It leverages Spring Boot annotations for request mappings, validation, and OpenAPI documentation via Swagger annotations.

classes.name: NoteController
classes.description: A REST controller for handling CRUD operations on notes, mapped to /api/notes

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note. Accepts a CreateNoteRequest and returns the created NoteResponse with HTTP 201.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of notes. Accepts Pageable, returns a Page of NoteResponse.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its id. Returns NoteResponse or 404 if not found.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs a full update (replace) of a note by id, requires all fields in UpdateNoteRequest.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Performs a partial update of a note by id, only provided fields are modified.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by id. Returns no content on success.
